class.name: robot_drive_status_broadcaster/DriveStatusBroadcaster
class.description: Whole-body MyActuator drive telemetry broadcaster. Claims TxPDO 0x1A02 state interfaces (motor_temperature, drive_temperature, bus_voltage, error_code) for every joint in the `joints` parameter and republishes each as a std_msgs/Float64MultiArray sized to the joint roster.
